headline: MYST's rocket flies — a fourth way to finish the island
lede: The metal door in the cave keeps its secret until you read it the Amatem note, and behind it the rocket waits: mount the saddle, throw the ignition, and ride the shaft into a darkening sky until the sea catches you at sunrise.

notes.text: The escape ending is live — ignite and the fixed-timestep loop flies you through liftoff, coast and splashdown; mid-flight the rocket drives you, not the arrow keys.
The Selenitic sound-book replays the six sounding-stone pitches, so the path order is learnable in-world, as in 1993.
Every lock still rides your seed (#1005): the seam, saddle and surf are the same island your codes stamped.
The board is otherwise parked: every flagship gap is shipped, owned by QA (#1002, #1008) or closed; the next pick comes from a fresh queue item or a QA release.

look.text: Ride the rocket: find the note on the Stoneship ridge, then the seam below …
Hear the sound-book on the Selenitic landing — six pages, six true pitches
